integrity: Analytic proof uses finite Fourier calculation and circle-map rotation-number characterization. Checker is confirmatory, not independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-parameter ε→0 asymptotic, no uniformity as q→∞.
Converse covers positive second-order width for odd q only; higher-order resonance not classified.
Publication priority relative to all classical normal-form literature not exhaustively established.
title: Quadratic Arnold-tongue onset from complementary Fourier harmonics
